title.narrative: Project for Enhancement of Youth Employment and Agency in West Nile Region

description.narrative: The overall result of this action is an economically and socially empowered youth through enhancement of employment and agency in West Nile region, Uganda by 2023. Result1 is the capacity of targeted 24,000 youth in 30 sub-counties built for (self) employment opportunities and agency increased by 60% compared to pre-project period. Result2 By mid-2022 at least 24,000 youth have been equipped with life-skills, bobby and advocacy skills to advocate for development and influence their own development options. 15% of the action will target refugee communities while 85% host community.
